BiblicalUsage: The word tsôwʼâh is the Bible's way of saying filth, excrement. In 2 Kings 18:27, that they may eat their own dung, and it appears again in Proverbs 30:12.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the filth this word names is what God washes away, and the proud who call themselves clean are the ones in danger.
